$comment: Example: Pickle Brawl's court, run by a node per placed match (node/gauntlet.js). ${node} is the node's own runtime (the court needs Node 22+). In node.env: GAUNTLETS=pickle-brawl.v1=<absolute path to this file>, GAUNTLET_GATEWAY_PORT=8478 (the gateway: the relay tunnel fronts it, and rooms it does not know go to the title relay on RELAY_PORT), COURTS=pickle-brawl.v1:<court public key>. cwd is the Pickle Brawl checkout (pnpm install, a built .dist/game.js); COURT_IDENTITY is the court key from npm run bridge -- key --kind attested --ruleset pickle-brawl.v1. Machine-specific: copy and edit.
